decision_basis: The project engineering baseline requires a Type K Class 2 or better temperature chain. For the low-temperature-rise upstream observations relevant to censoring, IEC 60584-1 Type K Class 2 tolerance is ±2.5 °C up to 333 °C. A baseline-to-observation temperature difference is assigned a conservative worst-case bound of 2×2.5=5.0 °C. The final detection threshold remains max(5.0 °C, case-specific LES noise from independent seed repeats); revise this requirement if a lower-grade sensor chain is selected.
